characters.description: Lancelot is the son of [Ban](https://anilist.co/character/77605/Ban) and [Elaine](https://anilist.co/character/86681/Elaine). He is also a Holy Knight of Liones, and one of the Four Knights of the Apocalypse.
Percival is the son of Ironside and grandson of Balgis, and is the main protagonist of the sequel, Four Knights of the Apocalypse.

Nasiens is a mysterious person Percival meets at Echo Gorge. Nasiens is a young person with short light brown hair and yellow eyes. Nasiens has a great interest in plants, wanting to be a herbalist like his adoptive grandfather Ordo was. He gets very excited when making new discoveries, liking to experiment with everything around him.

Anghalhad is a girl Percival meets at Sistana. Anghalhad is a young girl with long, fluffed pale cyan hair and turquoise eyes. She wears a white frilly dress with a magenta blouse along with socks and heels. She carries a dotted umbrella which hides a rapier in the center.

Donny is a member of the Katz Street Troupe. Donny is a tall teenager, with long red hair and is a bit burly. Donny wears a white button-down shirt, which leaves part of his chest uncovered, and black pants with some kind of pockets on the sides, and a pair of light-colored boots. Donny used to train as a Holy Knight apprentice under his uncle Howzer alongside his friend Edlin. However, seeing that he lacked the strength to become a Holy Knight, Donny dropped out of training and joined the Katz Street Troupe alongside Katz and Elva.

An Ayakashi Maiden who is the childhood friend of [Matsuri Kazamaki](https://anilist.co/character/175063/). She is one of few who can see ayakashi, and is often very friendly to them. However, her maiden status makes her a target for ayakashi with ill intentions.

A young boy who, along with his childhood friend [Suzu Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/174838/), can see ayakashi (a type of spirit). After he learned about Suzu's status as an Ayakashi Maiden from his grandfather, he became an exorcist ninja in order to protect her from harm.
A powerful ayakashi and the king of the ayakashi. He is after Suzu Kanade, wanting to consume her to increase his power.
Lucy is a classmate and friend of Suzu Kanade. She's a more silent and shy type, but she loves taking postworthy pictures of everything. She is usually always with Yayoi Toba.
Reo Kourogi is a Ninja of the Korogi clan and creator of Matsuri Kazamaki's ninja gear.

Milly Thompson is a fellow Bernardelli agent and friend and assistant to [Meryl](https://anilist.co/character/713/Stryfe-Meryl). Despite physically towering over Meryl, Milly looks up to her and always refers to her as "senpai," or "Ma'am" in the English Version, as a term of respect for a senior. Although physically very strong, she appears rather simple and ditzy, but has an extremely kind heart and also reveals a strength of character and genuine optimism. However, Milly can be just as hotheaded as Meryl if someone is disrespectful towards their family (or wasting food, especially pudding). She can seem somewhat dim, but she has some amazing skills (chess playing, for one) which hint at a deeply buried intelligence. She does have a tendency to go a bit overboard when drinking. She seemed to pick up on the fact that [Vash](https://anilist.co/character/162/Vash-the-Stampede) is the notorious Stampede before Meryl, but she is apparently still somewhat surprised upon realizing that she was correct. Milly comes from a very large family, and writes letters to them constantly (known as "The Milly Monthly"). Somehow Milly manages to hide a very heavy concussion gun (referred to as a "stun-gun") under her coat. The shots, which pop out into the shape of an X-shaped claw, are so powerful they can even knock over trucks. At one point Milly refers to herself as "Stun-gun Milly".

characters.description: __Race:__ Modified Human __Age:__ Unknown __Hair:__ Blue __Eyes:__ Gold __Height:__ About 6'1" (185 cm) __Weight:__ Unknown __Status:__ Leader of the Gung-Ho Guns Legato was recruited by Knives after the July incident to make Vash's life a living hell, though the nightmare doesn't really begin until about midway through the series. From that point on, this man continues to weave a living nightmare for Vash, not only on his own but also through the gang of eleven superpowered killers who are under his command: the Gung-Ho Guns. Legato himself possesses a dark power: the ability to control people's bodies against their will. ~!His favorite bit of poetic justice is to make gangs of people who oppose him shoot each other, and this special power is what finally forces Vash to cross the line he promised himself he'd never cross. By controlling some villagers and pointing their guns at Meryl and Milly, he forced Vash into a choice between two unacceptable options: either allow the girls to die, or take the only possible action to save them...and kill him. Legato's telekinetic powers come from the fact that he has Vash's left arm. When Knives shot it off, it was attached to Legato. This is why Legato can control other people's bodies (originally one of Vash's and Knives' powers) and can activate Vash's angel arm the same way Knives did in July. It is unclear how Vash's arm was transplanted to Legato, since Vash is a humanoid plant and Legato is human. One might think that perhaps Legato is also a humanoid plant, but it is made clear in the series that Legato is human and hates himself because of it. Thus we can only assume that Knives somehow "reconstructed" and modified Legato in some way.!~

Livio the Double Fang is a childhood friend of [Wolfwood](https://anilist.co/character/722/Wolfwood-Nicholas-D) and the final member of the Gung-Ho Guns from the Eye of Michael. He wields the Double Fangs, two small cross-shaped machine guns strapped on his arms that fire from both ends.

Midvalley the Hornfreak is a violent musician who is able to use his saxophone, Sylvia, to synchronize sound waves with pain, causing physical damage. He also is capable of neutralizing sounds by playing counter-frequencies. He and his band originally just kill for money until being found by Knives, who kills all except Midvalley. He dislikes both Legato and Knives, which leads him to try to kill Legato, though he is quickly killed himself. Legato uses Midvalley's body to attack Hoppered, and it is buried with his saxophone on his gravestone afterward. He has a smaller role in the anime, mainly acting as Legato's bodygaurd until fighting Vash, and killing himself after overloading his saxophone. from wikipedia

characters.native: エレンディラ・ザ・クリムゾンネイル
characters.description: The thirteenth Gung-Ho Gun and the most powerful, also referred to as "lost" number 13. She shoots giant red nails from a large briefcase that transforms into a crossbow. Like Vash, Elendira often acts childish and flippant, as well as flamboyant and sometimes extremely arrogant. She is a trans woman, and normally wears feminine clothing and a pillbox hat similar in style to fashions internationally popularized by Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis. However, underneath her outer garments she also wears restraining armour, and after disabling it, she is able to move at an even more inhuman speed than she is usually capable of. She seems to dislike Legato and fires a nail into Legato's torso in a conversation with him after arriving on a Zeppelin. It is also hinted that she holds some jealousy of Legato, commenting that Legato's lack of a number in the Gung-Ho Guns implies that Legato is on a whole other level from the Gung-Ho Guns, including Elendira herself. The only manga Gung-Ho Gun who does not carry one of the broken coins, Elendira did not appear at all in the anime.

characters.description: __Height:__ 140 cm (Season 2) / 162 cm (Season 3) __Team:__ Spica Her smile brightens the room. A festival-loving bucket of sunshine. Ever bright and cheerful, she loves festivals more than anyone else. Her innate altruism makes her unable to ignore a person in need, and she's always ready to lend an ear. Her bottomless kindness has earned her the admiration of those around her, but when she gets too excited, her words take on a certain festival flair. With a smile as bright as the sun, she continues to run towards the dazzling horizon, hoping that she will discover her true dream along the way.

__Height:__ 135 cm (Season 2) / 158 cm (Season 3) __Team:__ Capella Possesses a will harder than diamonds! She can handle any jinx! Born to an affluent house, she was showered with love and affection growing up. This sheltered upbringing has made her somewhat naive, but her gentle, honest demeanor hides a diamond-hard resolve. She trudges on resolutely, determined to break the Satono family's jinx and bring honor to her family.

__Height:__ 145 cm Bringer of misfortune? This racer pursues her dreams despite her dreary outlook. A timid Umamusume, she is under the impression that any misfortune befalling those around her is entirely her fault, when really, it's just bad timing. Nevertheless, she is determined to eradicate this supposed jinx of hers. She loves reading picture books in her spare time, especially "The Blue Rose of Good Fortune."

__Height:__ 158 cm Rar'n to go! A pure-hearted girl focused on her dream. Born in Hokkaido, Special Week is a bright and cheery, hardworking Umamusume. After losing her birth mother, Special Week was raised by her mother's friend. Now, she hopes to make both her moms proud by fulfilling her promise of becoming Japan's top racer. Though she may falter along the way, her indomitable spirit ensures that she runs ever forward.

__Height:__ 157 cm Don't expect much from her. This Umamusume is super cynical. An Umamusume of humble background with a penchant for being pessimistic. She tends to think of herself as a supporting character, and this causes her to shy away from high expectations—this sometimes leads to imperfect performances. She has quite the knack for cooking and cleaning due to her working-class upbringing, and does so whenever she has time. She's something of a familiar face among the seniors in her town.

Satan is the king of Gehenna. It has been said that he is the creator of every demon in existence. There is no body in Assiah powerful enough to host him because of his incredible powers.

__Height:__ 155 cm Konekomaru Miwa hails from Kyoto along with Ryuji Suguro and Renzo Shima and is an Exwire of the True Cross Order, a student of the Exorcist Cram School, and the surviving head of the Miwa family.

characters.native: アーサー・オーギュスト・エンジェル
characters.description: The newly appointed Paladin. He was ordered by the Grigori to to interrogate Mephisto and captured Rin as evidence. According to Shura he's a saint on the outside and a devil inside. Uses the demon sword Caliburn. Not much is known about Arthur so far, except that he is extremely loyal to the True Cross Order. He follows the orders of his superiors without questioning them at all, even attempting to kill people when they interfere with his work. He believes that anything related to Satan must be destroyed, as it could only cause harm to let them live. Arthur also seems to be slightly sadistic, as he stabbed Rin completely through the leg to immobilize him during Rin's trial, while remarking that the wound would heal soon enough. According to Shura, he is a saint on the outside and a devil on the inside, hinting that he may have a malicious personality.

Kinzou is the fourth son of the Shima family, Renzou's older brother. He seems to be a pretty simple guy who is ruled by his emotions, kicking his little brother in the head as a greeting and paying no attention to the conversation at breakfast, preferring to stuff his face.

He doesn't believe in things like magic or gods, claiming they are just laws of Physics. ~!He is the 8th fighter for Humanity in the Ragnarok Tournament, and his volund is with the 9th Valkyrie sister, [Gondoul](https://anilist.co/character/386569/Gondul).!~

characters.description: [Tokiwa's](https://anilist.co/character/321930/Tokiwa) college classmate who offered the mixer. She works at a crossdressing bar with [Fuji](https://anilist.co/character/321928/Fuji) and [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/321929/Kohaku) where she plays a handsome prince character. She attracts attention from women whenever she crossdresses.

Fuji works at the same crossdressing bar as [Suou](https://anilist.co/character/321927/Suou) and [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/321929/Kohaku) with a persona of a calm and collected guy with purple hair. Both in and out of character, she has an lethargic attitude but she is very attentive to her surroundings and supports others from behind the scenes. In her free time, she draws doujinshi and is always searching for reference material for her works.

Asagi is a college student and [Tokiwa's](https://anilist.co/character/321930/Tokiwa) friend. He has a friendly and immature personality, as well as a curiosity in all sorts of things. Somehow, he hit it off with [Fuji](https://anilist.co/character/321928/Fuji) and he helps her with her doujinshi.

Kohaku works at the same crossdressing bar as [Suou](https://anilist.co/character/321927/Suou) and [Fuji](https://anilist.co/character/321928/Fuji) with an aggressive "Ore-sama" persona which she struggles through with trial-and-error. Her earnest personality contrasts with the absurdity of Suou and Fuji's antics.
A normal college student who is classmates with [Suou.](https://anilist.co/character/321927/Suou) His thickheaded nature overcomes the charms of the crossdressing women.

**Height:** 145 cm (4′9″) **Camera:** Smartphone The president of the Cinema Studies Club. When all the senior students graduated, she was left behind (alongside fellow member "Ms. Tajima"), and like the Photo Club, Sakurako's club is on the verge of being completely dismantled.

**Height:** 165 cm (5′5″) **Camera:** Smartphone A 4-koma manga artist, using the pen name "Akino", and was a few steps shy of becoming a full-blown NEET. Lives with her grandmother who runs a cheap sweets shop.

Unfortunately, after her senpai's graduation, Satsuki was left in ruins, until she finally made the initiative to buy not just a camera -- but one that captures the world in 360-degrees!

**Height:** 175 cm (5′9″) **Camera:** Wide-angle action camera Kako is a motorcyclist who is into "motovlogging", often recording her scenic rides for people to watch on the Internet on WeTube — her "ISERIDER" account contains multi-part touring videos that might average 20,000 views.

Konoha has great passion for visual novels and bishoujo games. She admires both classic and modern games. She experienced big dissapointment when the company where she works at, hired her to illustrate background characters. Her biggest dream is to create her own game. She has a very childlike personality. She easily gets excited and prone to crying.

Alcoholsoft's resident programmer and the [president's](https://anilist.co/character/313990/Masaru-Rokuta) son. He is extremely confident in his own programming and has a near obsessive love of the PC-98. Despite programming for bishoujo games, he has no particular love for them.

Dejiko is the main character of Di Gi Charat. She is also known as Chocola but despite this alternate name implying she likes chocolate, she prefers broccoli. Dejiko has a Type A personality and can be aggressive at times. Dejiko dresses up as a catgirl and is the princess of Planet Di Gi Charat. She is ten years old when she comes to Earth with hopes of becoming an idol singer. She has green eyes and green hair and her maid-like uniform consists of a white and navy blue dress with big cat bells tied to her hair with navy blue ribbons. On the very top of her head are her cat ears, which are white with pink inside and have a set of large, non-functional yellow cat eyes. She always wears white gloves and boots (with the exception of her sleeping outfit) and she has a white tail. She has the ability to use her eye-beam weapon called the Me kara BEAM!. She ends each sentence with nyo.

Alcoholsoft's chief illustrator who is extremely skilled. She has a gentle personality. In the anime, she is the first person at Alcoholsoft to accept Konoha and worries about her when she disappears.

Artist and planner at Alcoholsoft with a trademark cat-eared hat. She has a gentle personality and a deep passion for Bishoujo games. She has a level-headed view of the company, but in the anime, Konoha's situation weighs on her mind.

__Magic:__ Virgo Magic An apprentice witch striving to become a First-Class Mage. She approaches everything with a positive attitude and treats those around her with warmth and cheer. Inspired by the mage who saved her during an incident two years ago, she now pursues the same path herself. A bit of an airhead at times.

__Magic:__ Sagittarius Magic A mage who turned into a cat due to a curse. With Spica’s power, he can temporarily lift the curse and return to human form. However, he reverts back into a cat once his magic runs out. In hopes of one day breaking the curse, he begins teaching Spica magic.

__Magic:__ Scorpio Magic The second daughter of the Scorpio Castle Shrine, from the Eastern lands. Due to a past incident, she keeps her distance from others. A bookworm with a strong aversion to insects (except scorpions).

title: 赛马娘 Pretty Derby ROAD TO THE TOP

characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm The lone star that shines brightest. She carries the weight of her immense resolve. A somewhat gloomy Umamusume who tends to avoid company. A certain tragedy that took place early in her life affects her deeply, even making her racing activities seem like an attempt to atone. Though she doesn't intend it, her stoic pessimism garners the interest and concern of those around her, and she often gets caught up in the antics of T.M. Opera O, one of her racing peers. ~!Admire Vega reveals that she was to be born with a twin sister, but that only one of them could survive until birth (presumably due to complications). Therefore she finds herself guilty of taking away her sister's right to run.!~

__Height:__ 166 cm An energetic honor student! ...But also kind of a supporting character? A spirited competitor practically overflowing with positive energy. She wants nothing more than to meet the expectations of her fans and is determined to surmount any challenge to do so. Her willingness to acknowledge and compliment her competitors' strengths has earned her the popularity and respect of her peers. Though she has the makings of a star, she often seems to find herself in more of a supporting role.

Extremely haughty. Her pride extends to the heavens! An Umamusume with an unbreakable spirit, King Halo is ready to overcome any challenge in order to be recognized by all as a first-class lady. Despite their strained relationship, she hopes to one day be recognized by her mother—a first-rate Umamusume and designer—and prove herself as a daughter. Yet to her gaggle of admirers at the academy, there's no doubt in their minds that she's already worthy of the title of "King," and they do not hesitate to regularly hail her as such.

__Height:__ 140 cm No matter how many times she falls, this girl always picks herself back up! She's on a losing streak... but she never gives up! While she may not be the most skilled, she experienced the excitement of racing back in Kochi and wanted more. While she completely flunked Tracen's entrance exam, her admissions officer was nonetheless impressed when they spoke by her boundless possibility—which she spreads to all the Umamusume around her. She is based on the internationally-famed racehorse of the same name with a record of 0 wins and 113 losses.

__Height:__ 164 cm In order to change her outlook and herself, this pessimist gives it her all. Her self-esteem droops as low as her ears. Things never seem to go quite right for this clumsy girl. Even so, she's determined to change herself for the better and doesn't want to ever give up, all for the chance at securing a brighter future. She admires [T.M. Opera O](https://anilist.co/character/140845/TM-Opera-O)'s grandiose self-confidence.

title: 明日方舟 冬隐归路

characters.description: __Place of Birth:__ Lungmen __Race:__ Lung __Height:__ 168 cm Ch'en, head of the Lungmen Guard Department's Special Inspection Unit, graduated from the Royal Victorian Guard School with superb grades and outstanding achievements. During her time with the Department, she cracked down on crime, fought violent offenders, tracked down armed fugitives, and brought down international criminals. Now works at Rhodes Island, providing on-site tactical command. ~!An Infected and the niece to [Wei Yenwu](https://anilist.co/character/189727/Yenwu-Wei), the regional leader of Yen-Lungmen. She has shown an aptitude for Originium Arts although she has a terrible control over it. But it is implied that using a sword as the conduit to her Arts gives her greater control over her Arts.!~ ~!She is the half-sister of the Reunion Movement Leader, [Talulah](https://anilist.co/character/216638/Talulah).!~

__Place of Birth:__ Ursus __Race:__ Cautus A Cautus Infected, born to a life of slave-mining in the Ursus tundra, FrostNova is a high-ranking member of Reunion. She leads the fearsome Yeti Squadron for special operations and is one of the few Casters who can suppress enemies in a head-on engagement. Saved by [Patriot](https://anilist.co/character/265827/Patriot) from her horrific life, FrostNova looks up to him as her father. ~!Sent by [Talulah](https://anilist.co/character/216638/Talulah) to attack Lungmen in coalition with Mephisto, they are held off by the combined efforts of Rhodes Island and Lungmen Guard Department before the Black Raincoats sweep in and lead a purge of the Lungmen Infected. With their roles now reversed, FrostNova stays back to help evacuate the slums even as her Oripathy worsens. She eventually confronts [Doctor](https://anilist.co/character/182729/Doctor) and [Amiya](https://anilist.co/character/174801/Amiya) who offer her a chance to join Rhodes Island. FrostNova agrees on the condition they beat her, on pretext of testing Amiya's resolve to defeat Talulah.!~ ~!Following their fateful encounter, the Doctor takes FrostNova's body with them so she could be properly cremated in one of Rhodes Island's incineration chambers as a sign of their honour and respect towards her, now a posthumous member of Rhodes Island.!~

__Place of Birth:__ Columbia __Race:__ Lupo __Height:__ 161 cm Texas is a Penguin Logistics staff member who is extraordinarily skilled in single combat. She was sent to Rhodes Island as a liaison, where she assists with a variety of operations.

__Birthday:__ Claims to have forgotten __Place of Birth:__ Kazdel __Race:__ Sarkaz __Height:__ 165 cm W, Sarkaz mercenary leader. W's squad, having been involved in Kazdel's lengthy civil war, is infamous for their brutal and efficient combat methods. W clashed with Rhodes Island during the Chernobog incident, but after defecting from Reunion for unknown reasons, signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Rhodes Island after negotiating with [Dr. Kal'tsit](https://anilist.co/character/174803/Kaltsit) in person.

__Birthday:__ Undisclosed __Place of Birth:__ Rhodes Island __Race:__ Feline __Height:__ 169 cm Kal'tsit, one of Rhodes Island's high-level administrative crew, and leader to Rhodes Island's medical projects. Profoundly learned in metallurgy, sociology, Originium Arts, archaeology, history and genealogy, economics, botany, geology, and other fields. In a portion of Rhodes Island operations, provides medical theory assistance and emergency aid apparatus as medical personnel. Simultaneously, active in many projects as a major constituent of Rhodes Island's command system. Kal'tsit has the ability to summon Mont3r, a biomechanical entity that seemingly comes out of her spine and is used for self-defense and in combat.

Yaiba lives with his father, Kenjurou, in the forest. One day, while Yaiba was eating, a troop of gorillas came to attack. Yaiba and his father escaped and hid inside a box, but they didn't know that the box was full of pineapples and was going to be transported into the city. In the city, Yaiba finds out that he is a legendary warrior and has to fight the evil of a demonic looking high-school student named Takeshi Onimaru.
Takeshi is the primary antagonist of Yaiba. Originally a very serious person, Onimaru could not get along with Yaiba at all and the two quickly became rivals.

One of the original eight demons who closely supported the Fuujin oni, reincarnated in the body of a frog and thus took the shape of his host. The first demon sent after Yaiba, he led a few skirmishes against Yaiba's party, but was eventually defeated and captured. Shortly after, the Snakeman demon appeared to both attack Yaiba and get rid of the Frogman due to his uselessness. Gerozaemon, with no place to return and a peaceful nature, was welcomed into Yaiba's group after the battle against the Snakeman. A melee fighter, he favors the use of body-slam techniques reminiscent of sumo, but can also skillfully use axes and his own tongue as weapons when needed.
Kurogane Kenjuro is Yaiba's father.

One of the original eight demons who closely supported the Fuujin oni, reincarnated in the body of a spider and thus took the shape of his host. Prefers to fight using head over brawns... but fails miserably at it: even though he is smart enough to create complex plans that actually work, his goofy nature causes them to backfire humorously most of the time. He becomes Onimaru's right hand man, not because of his merits but because there was nothing better at the time. He is constantly sent to do his master's bidding, such as recruiting new warriors or gathering intel. Even though he is part of Onimaru's ranks, he is actually not a bad guy. However, his undying loyalty towards his master is evident, but he never shows any real ill-will towards Yaiba's group. This trait also causes him to be the only one of the eight demons to back up Onimaru until the very end (the others either were slain, or changed sides), even though he is mistreated quite often.

The Demon King's precious only daughter. She has a kind heart, which is rare among demons, and she can't help but assist anyone in trouble, no matter who they are. As a candidate to be the next Demon King, she receives special elite education from Jahi, the demon lord's close aide, so that she can become a proper demon.

An excellent aide to the Demon King. She volunteered to be [Doux's](https://anilist.co/character/171744/Doux) tutor in order to guide her to become a respectable demon. Although she gives Doux one challenge after another, she is constantly at the mercy of Doux's excessive kindness.

He is the most powerful demon king in the demon world and [Doux's](https://anilist.co/character/171744/Doux) father. Despite his appearance as a demon king feared by the whole world, he is always a doting father when it comes to Doux. He worries so much about Doux's future that he even stops his world invasion.

[Jahi's](https://anilist.co/character/257292/Jahi) classmate. She belongs to the Parikar Squad, a group of demonic women skilled in bewitching men, but she's perpetually stuck as an apprentice, always up to mischief. To make [Doux](https://anilist.co/character/171744/Doux) a full-fledged demon, she proposes a trial of seduction.
[Ahriman's](https://anilist.co/character/367448/) wife and [Doux's](https://anilist.co/character/171744/Doux) mother.

A junior college student with little experience about camping alone. Shizuku got super interested in camping after trying to camp with friends for the first time. She decided to make Gen her mentor to develop her skills on camping alone, by contradictorily, camping together until she is able to manage on her own. She has a knack for cooking. Shizuku sometimes speaks in a heavy Kyushu dialect. She has an older brother.

His hobby is camping. An out-and-out solo camper who enjoys the quiet solitude away from the city. He doesn't own a car and instead prefers to use public transports such as a train or a bus. He loves every aspects of nature: fire, wood, water and soil. ~!He lost his father while camping during his childhood.!~
A solo camper who also likes biking. Is interested in Gen.
Shizuku's friend. Concerned about Shizuku frequently going camping with an older man.
Shizuku's friend. She is worried that Shizuku is going camping with an older man, but she also seems to be enjoying and cooperating with the situation.

title: 女神，我想转生异世界！我想成为勇者的肋骨

characters.description: A goddess in charge of reincarnation into another world who will let you reincarnate into another world until you are satisfied.

A young man who lost his life unexpectedly and was classified as a “Soul Type: Irregular.” To avoid the immense waiting time for popular reincarnation destinations, he repeatedly undergoes unconventional reincarnations—such as becoming the “rib” of a harem-cheat hero.
The mysterious sockeye salmon that reincarnates. The master of [Ore](https://anilist.co/character/388599/Ore), who possesses a super-powerful special move.
A gentleman who travels from one world to another in search of love. He likes pain.
The one and only god who created the original world. He also created other gods and created the multiverse.

A first year student and [Yuu's](https://anilist.co/character/354133/Yuu-Yuutani) childhood friend. Her poor eyesight makes her squint and she has naturally blonde hair so she is often mistaken for a delinquent. She often doesn't take Yuu seriously, but still cares about her and gives advice.

A first year student with perfect attendance, good grades, and even the respect of teachers. However, in order to get the attention of her beloved [Atori](https://anilist.co/character/354134/Atori-Mizutori) she acts as a poor imitation of a rule breaker. Her poor acting skills make her behave suspiciously when talking to Atori.

A second year student who uses her cute appearance as a weapon in her career as a beauty YTuber and model. She is popular and well known, even declaring herself the idol of the school, but has no friends.

A third year student who is admired by everyone both inside and outside of school. Some people have even begun to see her as a god-like figure. She is the head of the moral committee at school, but often acts eccentrically. She thinks of [Yuu]( https://anilist.co/character/354133/Yuu-Yuutani) like a small animal.

A friend of [Atori](https://anilist.co/character/354134/Atori-Mizutori) and head of the library committee at school. She is a beautiful and intelligent honor student, but she is also secretly known as a lady killer.

The protagonist of Your Forma. Echika is the youngest electronic investigator in the world and a standout talent when it comes to Brain Diving, so much so that her dives often cause her partners to suffer brain-related injuries whilst connected to her. This issue has lead to her being partnered with [Harold W. Lucraft](https://anilist.co/character/213705/Harold-W-Lucraft), a quick-witted and seemingly frivolous yet cutting-edge Amicus with equal skills to her.

characters.native: ハロルド・W・ルークラフト
characters.description: __Manufacture Date:__ Jan 9, 2015 The deuteragonist of Your Forma. Harold is a cutting-edge Amicus and an electronic investigator aide. He is the partner of [Echika Hieda](https://anilist.co/character/213704/Echika-Hieda), whom he frequently quips with and teases in an attempt to have her open up to him. While he often acts casually and flippantly he has incredible talents at deduction and reasoning, planning his every move many steps ahead.

A Sami girl who lives in Kautokeino, a technologically-restricted zone in Norway. She is a skilled bio-hacker who becomes acquaintances with [Harold](https://anilist.co/character/213705/Harold-W-Lucraft) and [Echika](https://anilist.co/character/213704/Echika-Hieda), having a crush on the former and disliking the latter due to the circumstances in which they met. However, they make up their differences afterwards, becoming close friends and allies.

characters.native: ソゾン・A・チェルノフ
characters.description: A detective in the Saint Petersburg City Police's burglary-homicide department, and husband of [Darya](https://anilist.co/character/324327/Darya-R-Tchernova). Sozon brought [Harold](https://anilist.co/character/213705/Harold-W-Lucraft) to his home after discovering him abandoned in an alley and quickly came to accept him as family. Taught Harold his rare deductive skills after taking him on as a partner. ~!He was murdered during the Nightmare of Saint Petersburg incident.!~

characters.native: ダリヤ・ロマーノヴナ・チェルノヴァ
characters.description: [Sozon](https://anilist.co/character/324329/Sozon-A-Chernov)'s wife. Accepted [Harold](https://anilist.co/character/213705/Harold-W-Lucraft) when her husband brought him home and treats him as family. ~!Following Sozon's murder she bequeaths her belongings to Harold, with whom she still lives and cherishes as a younger brother.!~

__Height:__ 184 cm (6’1) Masaki Takigawa is a senior shrine priest at Yata Shrine and later becomes the coach for the Kazemai High School Kyudo Club. He holds a fifth dan rank in kyudo. Masaki gives off the image of a mysterious, refined young man, but he is actually more laid-back and down-to-earth than he seems. He has the air of an old man despite his young age. He is noted to act roughly and sloppily in many things except in kyudo. He seems to dislike formality, asking everyone to call him "Masa-san" instead. He is friendly and good at explaining things, qualities that make him a good coach in the eyes of the members of the Kazemai kyudo club. He is also good at listening and giving advice, something he does with [Minato](https://anilist.co/character/128273/) frequently. He is not above speaking more vulgarly, such as when coaching Minato to overcome his hayake at the Yata no Mori Kyudojo. Despite his easy-going nature, Masaki also has a more serious and stubborn side to him when it comes to kyudo and his grandfather.
__Height:__ 174 cm A second-year student at Tsujimine High School and a member of its kyuudou club.
__Height:__ 176 cm A second-year student at Tsujimine High School and a member of its kyuudou club.
Yuuna Hanazawa is a first-year student at Kazemai High School and a member of the kyudo club.
Noa Shiragiku is a first-year student at Kazemai High School and a member of the kyudo club.
__Species:__ Werewolf A quiet, reserved, and passive werewolf girl who aspires to become human because she wants to be more than just a half-baked existence.

__Species:__ Rabbit A rabbit girl with a tendency to be a little harsh. Despite her sharp tongue, she's earnest at heart, and aims to become human in order to repay the kindness of those who once helped her.
__Species:__ Mozu A cool, gyaru Mozu girl. She's caring and acts as a leader in her class. She says she wants to become human so she can play music.

__Species:__ Mermaid A mermaid lady with a very bright and cheerful personality. She aspires to become human so that she can dance, which she loves, with her own two feet. She is always positive and optimistic, and is the mood maker.

__Species:__ Human A man in his 30s who loves games. For some reason, he quit his job as a teacher and stayed at his parents' house for a while, distancing himself from people. By chance, he becomes a teacher at Shiranui High School, a school where non-humans aim to become humans.

She is a Black Witch who lives in the depths of a forest. Despite her appearance, she is much older. She makes healing potions as a hobby and sells them in the next town. She is known as the Champignon Witch because anything she touches or walks over sprouts poisonous mushrooms. Anyone who touches her body also ends up suffering from side effects.
He is a boy that Luna finds wounded in the forest. His body shrinks after the removal of a curse.
He's a crow, familiar to a powerful wizard whom Luna respects. He is very harsh and often says mean things, but he does care about Luna.
He is a boy who comes into contact with Luna as a spirit for the first time. His family is part of a lineage of White Witches who are devoted to the royal family.
A magical cow creature who lives deep in the forest with [Luna](https://anilist.co/character/324197/Luna).

aliases: Anna Aveiro Nakamura dos Santos Moreira Cuccittini
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm A first-year high school student. Born and raised in Brazil, her mother is Japanese. She's a mood maker, assertive, and doesn't hesitate to speak her mind. She's skilled in capoeira, which she learned as a self-defense technique, and loves music.

__Height:__ 155 cm A first-year student at Omaebashi High School. She loves yoga, India, and philosophy. She doesn't like being overwhelmed and lives for peace and quiet, but she's constantly at the mercy of her childhood friend, [Anna](https://anilist.co/character/324909/Anna-Aveiro). Her delusional nature causes her to engage in rambling delusions that rival those of Bollywood.

__Height:__ 145 cm First-year student at Sakurajo Girls' High School. External student. Expressionless, taciturn, and extremely rational. She often gets talked about on social media for doing parkour to shorten her commute. In fact, she's not very dexterous, having trouble splitting chopsticks properly or tying sneaker laces properly.

__Height:__ 173 cm First-year student at Sakurajo Girls' Academy High School. An internal student. A sheltered young lady with a father who is the next director of a general hospital and a mother who is a former model. A tall and accomplished rhythmic gymnast, she is known as the "Fairy of Numata." Her earnest, humble, hardworking, and kind nature have earned her a devoted fanbase at school.

__Height:__ 155 cm A first-year high school student. She's cheerful, energetic, and loves cheerleading. Despite her bad luck, she's an exceptional athlete and won the national cheerleading championship in middle school. She and her best friend, [Megumi](https://anilist.co/character/324911/Megumi-Kaionji), are aiming to win the national cheerleading championship in high school as well.

__Height:__ 158cm The daughter of Shurinji Temple, a temple in Numata. In middle school, she was captain of the cheerleading club, but was hospitalized due to illness during a tournament. She is currently undergoing rehabilitation and recuperating at home. To fulfill her promise to [Kanata](https://anilist.co/character/324907/Kanata-Misora), she is a hard worker who studies diligently in order to transfer to Takanosaki High School. She is responsible and caring, but also has a tendency to tease Kanata. She is skilled at coming up with practice schedules and performances.

characters.native: ビクトリア・セラーズ
characters.description: A former operative skilled in a wide range of areas, including disguise, forgery, and combat techniques. Although she chose to leave the organization and live under the alias "Victoria," she struggles to fully break ties with her past and is awkward when it comes to pursuing her own happiness. However, through her encounters with Nonna and Jeffrey, she begins to carve out a new life for herself.

A young girl whom Victoria took in after she had been abandoned. Though she initially understood her situation and was quiet and well-behaved, she gradually becomes more emotionally expressive while living with Victoria. She deeply adores Victoria and has a profound impact on her, becoming a truly cherished presence in her life.

characters.native: ジェフリー・アッシャー
characters.description: The commander of the Second Knight Order, responsible for guarding the capital of the Kingdom of Ashbury. He is a man of integrity who enjoys the deep trust of those around him. When Victoria took Nonna under her protection, he stepped forward to act as her guarantor. Although he had long avoided falling in love due to emotional scars from an incident ten years prior, he finds himself drawn to the refreshing charm of Victoria, who lives her life with independence and spirit.

The proprietor of "The Black Thrush," a tavern located in the backstreets of the royal capital. He takes a liking to the way Victoria quietly enjoys her drink when she visits the establishment. Seeming well-versed in the affairs of the underworld, he and Victoria sense that neither of them is an ordinary individual.

characters.native: コンラッド・アシュベリー
characters.description: The Crown Prince of the Kingdom of Ashbury. He is a thoughtful and gentle-natured man who holds Geoffrey in high regard and is fond of him. Upon learning of Victoria—with whom Geoffrey is close—he seeks to give Geoffrey a push in the right direction.
A clone of the legendary Musashi Miyamoto, reanimated by the dark arts of Mitsunari Tokugawa's sister.

Chinese Kung-Fu (referred to as "Kenpo" in Japanese) practitioner. Trained in China and became the heir to his Kung Fu style in his temple. Despite his great knowledge in his style he does not open his mind to the possibility of learning from other disciplines at first but after striking up a friendship with Katsumi Orochi post tournament he appears to want to teach as well as learn at the Shinshinkai Dojo. ~!He fights Sergei Taktarov in round 1, Mount Toba in round 2, and destroys Orochi Katsumi in round 3. He then makes it to the semi-finals of the Maximum Tournament and is pitted against Baki Hanma where Baki nearly kills him by breaking his neck. In the "Search of Our Strongest Hero" saga, he has encounters with the British convict Hector Doyle and American convict Dorian. Retsu brings Baki to China to cure his poisoned body and have him fight in a Chinese Tournament. He reappears in Baki: Son of Ogre, during the Pickle saga, having a fight with the prehistoric man and losing it. He then gets his leg eaten by Pickle, as a "gift" for his victory. He later trains Katsumi so that he can become stronger before his fight with Pickle. Sometime afterward, it appears Retsu wants to take his plans to truly educate others about the Chinese martial arts global, and so he enters a boxing gym seeking strong opponents , the coach asks him to do a strength test by punching a bag with all his strength ,Retsu does so apprehensively and destroys the bag, a few days later at the gym a flash boxing promoter/manager enters the gym and sees Retsu practicing not boxing but a Kung Fu exercise just standing their maintaining his pose for nearly 2 hours, and an idea flashes in the manager's head and he arranges an exhibition match between a former champ and Retsu, during the course of his next few fights it appears Retsu has gained some respect for Western fighters as well as showing them how to absorb damage, hit with absolutely all their strength and use lightning speed, (as well as making millions in the process for these exhibition matches but seemingly completely indifferent towards the money).!~

A karate master and head of the shinshinkai-kan.One of the only people in the world able to stand toe-to-toe with Yujiro. He whips his students into shape by fighting them regularly, and practices all of his karate techniques at least one thousand times daily. A very devoted karate practitioner, and a mentor of Baki's. Also the instructor of Katou and father of Katsumi. He fought Yujiro, who gouged his eye out and killed him. However, Doppo was revived by Kureha. He eventually fights the escaped American convict Dorian in the 'Search of our Strongest Hero' manga series. Dorian manages to cut off Doppo's hand with a strange wire-cutting technique in which he uses a wire blade projected from a lighter. Doppo later avenges this loss when he, Katsumi, and Retsu track Dorian down. Shortly after this however, Dorian escapes from the hospital and uses an explosive that is implanted into his hand to blow off part of Doppo's face. This however, does not kill him, but leaves many scars on his face. (Source: Wikipedia)

Master of the ancient jujutsu arts used by the samurai soldier-warriors of feudal Japan. Is just over seventy years of age, and has trained since prior to World War II, in the "old days" of the martial arts. His art makes use of the martial arts principle of aiki, which uses the opponents' attacks against him. Manages to make it all the way through to semi-finals in the Maximum Tournament series and battles against Jack Hanma. In his third match with Doppo, Goki is shown to act in an insane manner while fighting. He also states that he's killed many people. He later teams up with Baki to face the Japanese convict Yanagi Ryukou in the 'Search of Our Strongest Hero' series. He also has a friendly sparring match with Biscuit Oliva and another match with Mohammad Ali Jr. In the Maximum Tournament, he faces Roger Harlon in round 1, and Shinogi Koushou in round 2 before facing Doppo in round 3 and losing to Jack Hammer in round 4. When not fighting, he's quite eccentric (as well as a bit senile) as he lives the day and fears nothing. Although in the series Goki is said to be a master of the old style of jujutsu, and when he fights Doppo it is said that he represents Jujitsu, most Goki's techniques looks like Aikido, and even Goki himself resembles the Aikido Master Gozo Shioda, founder of the Yoshinkan Aikido.

Yūko Maekawa - A 3rd dan, Doppo's son and current prodigy of Shinshinkai karate. ~!He fights Roland Gustof in round 1 defeating him easily before fighting Hanayama Kaoru and fighting a more even round 2 using his sonic fists technique. In round 3 he loses miserably to Retsu Kaioh getting knocked out in 1 punch. Retsu was impressed that Katsumi could take one of his punches. A rematch in the 'Search of Our Strongest Hero' series is interrupted when the convict Dorian comes into the Shinshinkai building and attacks Katsumi. Katsumi also later trains the convict Doyle in Shinshinkai Karate. In the anime it is revealed that Doppo is actually Katsumi's adoptive father. The final moments of the anime show him washing up at Doppo's home. He has a fight with Pickle which he loses despite his new Mach Punch technique, and as a result he got his right arm torn off and several limbs broken. He is seen in hospital recovering from his wounds shortly after.!~

title: 被遗弃圣女的异世界美食之旅

characters.description: She was summoned to another world, only to get kicked out in a split second. Her hobbies are solo camping, cooking, and TRPGs, but now she's living the ultimate *real-life* RPG dream! The chance to hunt, cook, and eat her own food? It’s absolutely the best! She'll be doing her best as the cook and pack-mule for the adventurer party "Gluttony’s Table"! Oh, and apparently, she is a Saint or something.

He’s the first "Ogre-Dragon" guy [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/394148/Rin-Takanashi) met in this other world. He’s a highly skilled adventurer and the leader of the "Gluttony Table." Sure, he’s got a bit of a high "fuel consumption" and looks intimidating, but he’s a gentleman—kind, strong, and handsome to boot! He’s a total feast for the eyes. He’s definitely a favorite of Rin! Oh, and he loves eating delicious food.

She’s a beauty and a member of the "Gluttony Table." Watching her fight using threads is so cool—it practically brings back memories of [Rin's](https://anilist.co/character/394148/Rin-Takanashi) sealed-away "chuunibyou" phase! Plus, she smells amazing and is so soft; getting a tight hug from her makes Rin go "hehehe"... She’s totally best-girl material! It’s also wonderful how head-over-heels in love she is with her husband, [Edo](https://anilist.co/character/398642/Edo). Oh, and she absolutely loves eating delicious food.

He’s a magic alchemist and a member of the "Gluttony Table." He’s cheerful and personable, but he absolutely dotes on his wife, [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/398641/Aria); whenever Aria and [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/394148/Rin-Takanashi) give each other a tight hug, he shoots her a really intense look... It’s just friendship—pure friendship! Still, seeing how head-over-heels they are for each other is just the best. Oh, and he loves eating delicious food.

A winged cat we encountered in a certain dungeon. Apparently, it’s the offspring of a monster known as a... well, whatever it is. But such details don't matter when faced with that fluffiness! It acts a bit haughty, but it’s actually a total cuddle-bug that loves anyone who dotes on it.
__Type:__ Alpha Oldest son of [Masaki](https://anilist.co/character/326835/) and [Hiromu](https://anilist.co/character/326836/).

__Type:__ Omega Full-time househusband with low self esteem. Husband of [Hiromu](https://anilist.co/character/326836/) and father of [Hikaru](https://anilist.co/character/326837/) and [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/326838/).

__Type:__ Alpha Businessman with excessive love for his family. Husband of [Masaki](https://anilist.co/character/326835/) and father of [Hikaru](https://anilist.co/character/326837/) and [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/326838/).
__Type:__ Beta University student who lives near the Fujiyoshi house. He is close friends with [Tomohiro](https://anilist.co/character/326840/).
__Type:__ Alpha Childhood friend and coworker of [Hiromu](https://anilist.co/character/326836/).

He was an aristocrat who served as the prime minister of a large nation in a certain world, but one day he was suddenly transported to another world. After being transported to that world, he became an adventurer and decided to enjoy life in another world, calling it a "vacation". He has a very calm way of speaking and behaving, and is also endowed with an excellent mind.

Nicknamed "The Blade," he is the strongest adventurer. He has a mean look in his eyes. He is skilled in human combat and monster subjugation. He also has a high ability to sense presence, making his abilities as an adventurer impeccable. Originally, he was a lone wolf who didn't flatter or obey anyone, but after meeting Lizel, he became his partner.

He is an employee of the Adventurer's Guild in the royal capital of Parteda. He rarely expresses emotions and generally remains expressionless at all times. Due to his emotionless appearance and the ice-element magic he uses, adventurers fear him and call him "Absolute Zero." He is adept at anything from desk work to heavy lifting. He is an old friend of [Judge](https://anilist.co/character/380597/Judge).

A snake-like beastman. He is a solo adventurer. He has a charming smile, but contrary to his appearance, he has a very aggressive and violent personality. He has the flexibility and speed of a snake itself, and is skilled in the use of weapons.

A tall man who runs a tool shop in the royal capital of Parteda. He has a timid personality and is reserved with everyone he interacts with. However, he can also make assertive statements at times. He has an excellent eye for appraisal, and sometimes helps appraise labyrinth items and monster materials brought to the Adventurer's Guild.

Tsunagu is reserved, calm, and doesn't express that much emotion, due to the discrimination that beastmen such as him are put through whenever they enter into human cities. Tsunagu is well aware of the fact that Beastmen have been stereotyped as violent and easily provoked, and so Tsunagu attempts to limit himself from expressing too much emotion, especially not anger.

Yukihiro Aida is calm, observant, and remarkably steady compared to the more volatile Beastfolk characters around him. His loyalty is deep and sincere; once he cares about someone, he’s unwaveringly protective.

A cat-species beastman. She is Tsunagi’s childhood friend, and they were raised together like siblings. She loves Tsunagi deeply and initially harbors a strong sense of rivalry toward Mari, but after coming to know Mari’s straightforward nature, she gradually begins to support the two of them and their relationship. She was wary of humans at first, but through her interactions with Mari and Yukihiro, she grows and matures. She loves fashion and is confident in her sense of style.

A friend and classmate of Mari. Her hobby is writing novels, and her dream is to become a novelist. Her parents, who prioritize studying, allowed her to write novels on the condition that she always get first place in tests, but after meeting Tsunagu, she begins to think about how to face her parents and her dreams. Although she is usually cool, she becomes childishly dependent on her childhood friend Ritsuka. Together with Ritsuka, she supports Mari and Tsunagu's romance.

A classmate of Mari and her friends. He is uncomfortable with beastmen living in the same environment as humans and frequently targets Tsunagi with harassment. He hates lies and is willing to be alone if that is what it takes to live honestly and true to himself, making him a principled person in his own way. However, this defiant attitude often leads to misunderstandings from those around him, and at times it can even escalate into trouble.

The eldest son of the Mitsukiya family. A fifth-grader in elementary school. A boy with blonde hair and blue eyes, he looks like a beautiful Caucasian girl. Because he receives hand-me-down feminine clothes in place of his tomboyish older sister, [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/382212/), he usually dresses in girls' clothes. He is more outgoing and free-spirited than his sister, and consciously uses his cuteness as a weapon to involve those around him, including adults, and act freely. His spiritual power is above average, but not as high as his sister's.

The eldest daughter of the Mitsukiya family. A second-year middle school student. She has short black hair and a boyish appearance. She has an outgoing personality and often acts together with her younger brother, [Kaoru](https://anilist.co/character/382213/). She is courageous and, even upon first meeting [Dara](https://anilist.co/character/382211/), is not intimidated and quickly becomes friendly with her. She possesses remarkable psychic abilities, to the point that Dara is amazed, and is sensitive to spiritual phenomena that ordinary humans cannot perceive.

[Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/382212/) and [Kaoru's](https://anilist.co/character/382213/) mother. A middle-aged woman with a voluptuous figure. She closely resembles Hinata in appearance. She has been in charge of managing the forbidden areas and shrines since high school, in place of her father, [Hyougo](https://anilist.co/character/382214/). During her high school years, she was able to perceive [Dara-san](https://anilist.co/character/382211/) and was even saved by her. Because of that experience, she worships Dara-san not as an object of fear, but as a god protecting the cursed objects enshrined in the shrines.

Neighbor to the Misogiya family. She is an introverted, bespectacled otaku girl with a fear of men. She makes a living from home as a freelance developer. She likes [Kaoru](https://anilist.co/character/382213), and has the ambition to marry him when he becomes an adult, even though he is still in elementary school.

[Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/382212)'s classmate. A girl who was in the same kindergarden class as Hinata. She ended up going to a private elementary and middle school, but was teetering on the border of life and death after [Yamatagi Madara](https://anilist.co/character/400573/) forcibly possessed her. She narrowly survived due to the effects of her supernaturally-accelerated spiritual growth. After aging from 12 years to 15 years old during her brief coma, she had a period of rehab, and then returned to school. Her body is now roughly 16 and a half years old, but her mind is still that of a 12 year old. Despite having enough raw spiritual power to be acknowledged by the great demon, her spiritual sense is poor, so she is completely unaware of her situation.

Yi Huan is a Vice General who serves in Great General Ao Meng's army. In the past, he was a bandit leader with the moniker Yi Huan the Beheader. His personality is said to be extremely brutal as he has no qualms in killing surrendered soldiers and personally beheaded every person in any city or village he conquered. This is shown in how he sends Wei soldiers, who have been severely tortured, along with bags of eyeballs back to their camp to decrease morale and incite fear. He always has an arrogant smirk on his face and talks in a crude manner at times. He shows no respect for his foes as he calls Feng Xuan "an old fart" and "trash" before killing him. He is exhibits a sense of humor and sarcasm as in the case when a fellow crew member asked him why he made an unskilled man named Ogiko as 1000-man commander of The Yi Huan army, he replied "Gyahaha cause it's funny obviously." He also has a cool demeanor and almost never displays any shock no matter how bad the situation is. Yi Huan also shows a very dark side as he toys with Xi Bai Gui by dangling the idea of escape from death if he begged for his life then stabbed him several times after he refused to grovel. He does exhibits a sense of loyalty exclusive to Ao Meng by holding the rank of Vice General in his army and coming when summoned as demonstrated when Tang Zhang used Ao Meng's name, as he knew that Yi Huan would simply ignore an request for a conversation with him.
One of the 3 great heavens generals of Zhao. ~!He marries [Yin Hai](https://anilist.co/character/132035/Hai-Yin) later on in the series.!~

Chang Ping is one of the Four Pillars of Ryo and the Chancellor of the Right in the Qin court. He is a strategic genius and the Head of Military Affairs under King Zheng Ying of Qin. In the strategist academy, he instructed Mou Ten, Mou Ki, ​and Ten in the ways of strategic warfare.

A merchant who ranked up as Qin's Right Chancellor. ~!Shortly after he is introduced, it is revealed that he is planning to keep his army in Wei until Zheng Ying dies, then storm Qin's capital of Xianyang, denouncing Jiao Cheng as a tyrant and taking the throne for himself. !~
Ping Wei is one of the squad leaders of the Fei Xin Force. He comes from the same village as Xin, the village of Jouto.

__Height:__ (Publicly) 165 cm Elder twin brother of the Yatonokami family. He is an orphan in a poor city, raised by adults who oppressed him; thus he hardly trusts anyone. He is careless and tends to find things troublesome, but is devoted and will do anything for his twin brother, Nayuta. As of now, both of the twins are living off the money that they make from rapping for shady underground business.

__Height:__ 175 cm Their appearance takes that of a fashionable modern girl, but in reality, they are the manliest one in BAE. In their younger years, they were oppressed by their old-fashioned and strict mother. Because of that, they decided to live true to themselves. Right now, they are working part-time as a hostess, taking advantage of their good looks.

__Height:__ 185 cm Born in one of the most prominent financial conglomerate family in Korea. Due to his demeanor and looks, he was nicknamed 'Smiling Young Noble', but he is actually quite sadistic in nature. Because he was born in a complicated environment swirling in conflicting interests and ulterior motives, he lived half of his life very fiercely and swore to take revenge on both of his parents in his heart.

__Height:__ 178 cm A young man who loves hip-hop above all else. He has a scary look in his eyes and isn't friendly, so people find him hard to talk to, but he's actually just awkward. He was born a quarter-Russian to a pianist father and an opera singer mother. He is also from a well-known musical family, but he left home after his parents disapproved of his passion for hip-hop.

__Height:__ 175 cm Cheerful leader of AKYR. He is always smiling, but his feelings are unreadable. As he has been in the underground world for a long time, he somewhat lacks common sense between good and evil. He treasures the members like family members and has set his heart on creating a place for them.

__Height:__ 183 cm Naokira is a member from The Cat's Whiskers. He leads a double life as a linguistic professor by day and a bar owner by night. He's always calm and collected. He treats everyone kindly without discrimination and can't abandon anyone who is in trouble. He harbors a deep attachment for the bar he's managing currently.

__Height:__ 166 cm He has a passive and introverted personality. When he ran away from home before, he was picked up by [Saimon](https://anilist.co/character/291461/Saimon-Naoakira) and started working at the bar. Just like that, he becomes a freeloader who works as a hall staff. Constantly nervous and have absolutely no self-confidence but, he excels at being able to recall any song just by listening to it once - his hidden talent.

A young pilot who fights against galactic monsters with his robot partner [Yukio](https://anilist.co/character/242828/Yukio). He belongs to the anti-monster battle front "E-RDE" and is known as the "savior" who protects the Earth. He is extremely shy and has no friends other than Yukio, but his abilities are well-known.

[Tetsuo's](https://anilist.co/character/242827/Tetsuo-Yabusame) partner and the robot that battles galactic monsters. A kind-hearted character who looks after Tetsuo, who struggles with communication. ~!He self-destructed in battle, but transmitted all his data to an escape pod and was restored.!~

A curious kaiju tamer who lives in Mishima Mall. She controls a fiery monster called "Human Earth" to protect the village. She also serves as the mall's accounting manager, but is often scolded for skipping work.

The eldest daughter of the Takimura family living in Mishima Mall. An engineer who inherited her mother's passion for research, possessing advanced technical skills sufficient to create close-combat weapons against kaiju. Her natural cheerfulness allowed her to quickly warm up to the shy [Tetsuo](https://anilist.co/character/242827/Tetsuo-Yabusame).
A member of the "Light of E-RDE (Vierde)." He controls a kaiju called "Eros (Marshal's Arrow)" and calmly and coolly picks off his targets.

A Digimon born from Tomorou's Sapotama. Always hungry, satisfying its appetite is its top priority. Sticks its nose into everything and charges ahead without thinking about the consequences. (Source: Official Site) Note: Not to be confused with the similarly named [Gekomon](https://anilist.co/character/316018/Gekomon).

Golden Dawn's loose cannon. Her role is to attract enemies on the front lines. In an attempt to break through stalemates, she often runs out of e-Pulse and collapses. (Source: DIGIMON BEATBREAK Official Site)
Leader of the Golden Dawn. A genius cleaner with top-class abilities. He calls his friends "family" and cherishes them. (Source: DIGIMON BEATBREAK Official Site)

Tends to take a critical look at everything. Influenced by his older brother, he often taps out rhythms with his drumsticks. He joins the Golden Dawn for a certain purpose. (Source: DIGIMON BEATBREAK Official Site)
Makoto's partner Digimon. He has an otaku personality and isn't satisfied unless he checks out anything that catches his eye. He has a habit of muttering to himself. (Source: Official Site)

Responsible for Golden Dawn's analysis and "the annoying stuff" (according to Reina). Although he has a serious personality, he can sometimes be ruthless with his words towards others. (Source: DIGIMON BEATBREAK Official Site)
Kyou's partner Digimon. Although it boasts overwhelming strength in battle, it's usually found sleeping in its pre-evolved form, Cougarmon. (Source: Official Site)
Reina's partner. Looks like a raccoon, and has a big sister personality. Grew up like family together with Reina from a young age. (Source: Official Site)

A woman who writes a serialized manga about shogi (Japanese chess) in a girl's manga magazine. She is a rookie manga artist whose current work is her first serialization, and was Takizawa's assistant until the serialization was decided. She is shy and paranoid, and often receives various criticisms from her assistant Mizuki Hazama. She is trusted by Kaede Satou, the editor in charge of the series, because she always manages to produce work of a certain quality or higher even when the schedule is tight. She is also known as a "genius" among her collaborators such as Satou and Hazama, but she evaluates herself as "less than ordinary".

A talented assistant to [Nana Futami](https://anilist.co/character/298294/Nana-Futami). Although she has been the talk of the town on social media many times, she has given up on the idea of ​​being a manga artist and continues to work as an assistant. Futami calls her "Ha-san."

[Nana Futami's](https://anilist.co/character/298294/Nana-Futami) editor. She appreciates Futami's talent, but is shy and doesn't praise her much. Although she seems to be the one to lead, she often forgets to tell Futami important things, causing her trouble.

She was diagnosed with Sensorineural hearing loss when she was five years old. She isn't entirely deaf; if she has a hearing aid, the room is quiet, and she can see the other person's lips, she can hold on a conversation.

Manga artist. Serialized a romantic comedy manga in a boys' magazine. A senior from [Nana Futami's](https://anilist.co/character/298294/Nana-Futami) assistant days who somehow ended up hanging around Futami's house constantly... Loves alcohol.

title: BIRDIE WING -高尔夫少女的故事- 第二季

characters.description: Eve is the main protagonist of the BIRDIE WING: Golf Girls' Story series. She is a survivor who made a living by betting on golf. Her struggling past resulted in a rough and powerful playing style. ~!In Part 2, it is revealed that Eve is the daughter of famed golfer Kazuhiko Amawashi and Elanor Burton, the daughter of the CEO of Arios, who both were victims of a tragic cruising accident which also resulted in Eve's amnesia!~

Aoi Amawashi is the daughter of the Tenwashi Group, one of the largest corporations in the world, and a thoroughbred in the golf world. Being the ace of the prestigious Raijin Girls’ Academy golf club, Aoi became known as the "Innocent Tyrant" as she enjoys golf and defeats her opponents with a sweet and innocent smile ~!In Part 2, it is reveled that Aoi's father is not famed golfer Kazuhiko Amawashi, but instead is Reiya Amuro, her coach. Aoi sadly seems to also have inherited Reiya's health problems, as she is seen to struggle with a form of fatigue like Reiya did.!~

Reiya Amuro is the head coach of the golf team at Raijin Girls’ Academy. A former professional golfer who's pro career was cut short, Reiya manages the golf team and acts as Aoi's mentor as she progresses in her own pro career. He also brings Eve onto the team and teaches her to a degree. ~!In Season 2, it is revealed that Reiya is more than just Aoi's coach, he is also her biological father. In his last game as a professional golfer, where Reiya was playing for the right to marry his lover, fellow golfer Seira, a sudden physical illness forced him to drop out of the competition, causing him to lose both the tournament and Seira's hand to Kazuhiko Amawashi. Yet beforehand, he managed to get Seira pregnant with his kid, who would be Aoi. Kazuhiko found out about Reiya and Seira's kid, and agreed to raise Aoi as his own daughter, keeping the affair secret from the public. After hiding the truth from Aoi for fifteen years, Reiya eventually would confirm Aoi's suspicions that he was her real father.!~

characters.native: レオ・ミラフォーデン
characters.description: Leo Millafoden is an underground golfer and Eve's golf coach for much of her childhood. Through Leo, Eve was able to learn how to use "Bullets", high-energy golf swings. Eventually, Leo left Eve on her own. ~!It is revealed that Leo also tutored Rose Aleon, Eve's main underground golf handler, but quit being her mentor when Rose continued to get herself further and further into the mob scene!~ ~!It is revealed in Season 2 that Leo was unbeatable, and only Kazuhiko Amawashi was able to defeat him in a match. Inspired by Kazuhiko's skills as a golfer, Leo made it his goal to combine Kazuhiko's and his skills into one golfer to create the greatest golfer. He found his opportunity upon discovering that Kazuhiko had a surviving daughter named "Eve", and sought her out in the hopes she inherited Kazuhiko's skills so that he could instill his techniques into her to achieve his goal!~
Eve's mother. ~!It is later revealed that, behind the public facade of Kazuhiko and Seira's marriage, Eleanor and Kazuhiko were lovers and had Eve together.!~

Mysterious new landlord of Astro-sou who arrived 3 months ago and doesn't know about many common things like smartphones. She is secretly an alien princess who came to earth to look for a key hidden at Astro-sou.
The live-in chef of Astro-sou and resident of room 5. He used to work at a hotel restaurant, but is currently unemployed and has a crush on [Mira](https://anilist.co/character/319946/).

Resident of Room 7 who became a shut in after she was invited to live at Astro-sou by the previous owner [Tasuke.](https://anilist.co/character/337248/Tasuke-Shimotakaido) The other residents didn't even realize she lived there until she was caught stealing the food [Takumi](https://anilist.co/character/319947/Takumi-Miyasaki) made. She has a crush on Takumi and a connection to his past.
Resident of room 6 and underground idol. She performs under the name Terurun and is a self proclaimed ego-searching demon.
Alien who resembles a poodle, who came to Earth as [Mira's](https://anilist.co/character/319946/) guard. He acts like a dog around others, but dislikes it.

__Height:__ 178 cm __Affiliation:__ Northern Country __Magic Tool:__ Trunk __Skill:__ Talks to animals Owen is a wizard that resides within the Northern Country. A sarcastic guy with a foul mouth; he enjoys the fearful eyes of people and has no faith in others. A dangerous person who is cautious of other wizards.

Nero is a wizard that resides within the Eastern Country. Best known as the Eastern Country‘s best cook. He avoided the hassle and lived a solitary life, concealing himself from being a wizard. He is apathetic and indifferent towards others. However, he is good at taking care of people and has an anxious side. He’s a hardworking wizard.

He believes that in the future humans and wizards can live together in harmony.

aliases: Chloe Collins (クロエ・コリンズ)
characters.description: Chloe is a wizard that resides within the Western Country. A bright and sociable person. Although he seems like a bubbly guy, he gets depressed easily and sometimes loses his confidence. He aims to be a tailor and is traveling with his magic teacher, Rustica.

__Height:__ 185 cm __Affiliation:__ Central Country __Magic tool:__ Wand __Skill:__ Destruction magic Oz is a wizard that resides within the Central Country. He is known as the strongest wizard who is feared by many people.

aliases: Rustica Ferch‚ Rustica Ferucci (ラスティカ・フェルチ)
characters.description: Rustica is a wizard that resides within the Western Country. An elegant but leisurely gentleman. He travels around the world with his disciple, Chloe, looking for his lost bride. He does not know how to care for himself, so Chloe often takes care of him instead.

__Height:__ 165 cm __Affiliation:__ Central Country __Magic tool:__ Lantern __Skill:__ Leadership Riquet is a wizard that resides within the Central Country. He was raised as an apostle of God in a certain cult.
White is a wizard that resides within the Northern Country. He is the twin brother of the wizard, Snow. He always watches over the other wizards with Snow.

Snow is a wizard that resides within the Northern Country. He is the twin brother of White. He is known to usually take on the appearance of a child, but he can also change his appearance to resemble that of an adult. He is rumored to be alive for thousands of years. Thoughtful and majestic, but sometimes mischievous.

aliases: Lennox Ram (レノックス・ラム)
characters.description: Lennox is a wizard that resides within the Southern Country. A silent shepherd youth. At first glance, he seems unapproachable and hard to talk to, but he’s very sincere when you get to know him. He holds a lot of trust with Figaro and the other Southern wizards. He believes it’s better to fight with his bare hands than to use magic.

aliases: Mitile Flores (ミチル・フローレス)
characters.description: Mitile is a wizard that resides within the Southern Country. Rutile’s younger brother. He is sometimes cheeky and he is spoiled since he is one of the youngest. An honest and hardworking boy. He trains under Figaro in order to become a strong wizard.
